reason: My doctor said my magnesium could be low, and the named lab with the report for my exact batch is more than most TikTok Shop brands show. At $24.99 for the first box it is about 83 cents a day, so I would try one box, not two.
objection: Only one form of magnesium when other brands put 8 forms in one capsule. Is bisglycinate alone enough, and is 200 mg a real dose? I would also wait to see if the price drops further in a flash sale.
would_change_my_mind: If the first-box price were not $24.99, or I found a similar tested bisglycinate for less per day, I would pass.
